# MatchClaim { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchClaim }

```python
alignment.MatchClaim()
```

A claim that two events on different timelines correspond.

A MatchClaim always knows which two timelines it connects via top-level
``timeline_a_id`` and ``timeline_b_id`` fields, and it names the events
it is about: an explicit claim names an event on each side, or one event
and the NOMATCH sentinel (``None``) on the other. It never states a bare
coordinate: a side without an event of its own is given a Projection
event first. Anchors are only present for synchronous claims, and each of
their coordinates is on its timeline's own axis (:meth:`check_on_timelines`).

## Four cases {.doc-section .doc-section-four-cases}

(a) ``from_events``: Two events on different timelines correspond
    (synchronous, with anchors; or conceptual, without).
(b) ``nomatch``: An event has no equivalent on the other timeline.
(c) ``implicit``: Implicit claim generated by MatchGraph group
    extension (derived, never stored as a statement).

| Name              | Type                                                                      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|-------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| timeline_a_id     | [str](`str`)                                                              | First timeline's unique identifier.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| timeline_b_id     | [str](`str`)                                                              | Second timeline's unique identifier.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| start_anchor      | [AlignmentAnchor](`timetoalign.alignment.claims.AlignmentAnchor`) \| None | AlignmentAnchor for event starts (None for non-synchronous).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| end_anchor        | [AlignmentAnchor](`timetoalign.alignment.claims.AlignmentAnchor`) \| None | AlignmentAnchor for event ends (None for instants or non-synchronous claims).                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| is_synchronous    | [bool](`bool`)                                                            | True if temporally synchronous matches.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| is_explicit       | [bool](`bool`)                                                            | True if directly claimed, False if inferred.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| provenance        | [Provenance](`timetoalign.core.provenance.Provenance`) \| None            | How the claim was made and who believes it (:class:`~timetoalign.core.provenance.Provenance`).                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| certainty         | [float](`float`) \| None                                                  | How certain the claim is, in [0, 1] (1.0, certain; ``None``, not stated).                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| source_claim_id   | [str](`str`) \| None                                                      | For implicit claims, the ID of the claim that generated this one.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| event_a_id        | [str](`str`) \| None                                                      | ID of the event on timeline A (``None``: the NOMATCH sentinel).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| event_a_name      | [str](`str`) \| None                                                      | Name/label of the event on timeline A (if known).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| event_b_id        | [str](`str`) \| None                                                      | ID of the event on timeline B (``None``: the NOMATCH sentinel).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| event_b_name      | [str](`str`) \| None                                                      | Name/label of the event on timeline B (if known).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| source_coordinate | [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`) \| None                       | The position of a NOMATCH claim's event, on the timeline of its event. None for synchronous claims, whose coordinates are held by the anchors instead.                                                                                                                                           |
| id                | [str](`str`) \| None                                                      | The claim's identifier, unique in the scope holding the claim (a :class:`MatchClaimField` or an ``AlignmentBundle``). It never changes once given: a scope already holding it refuses the claim. A claim made without one holds ``None`` until the first scope it joins mints one (``claim_N``). |
| id_minted         | [bool](`bool`)                                                            | Whether ``id`` was minted by a scope rather than given.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> from timetoalign.timelines.types import (
...     ContinuousLogicalTimeline,
...     ContinuousPhysicalTimeline,
... )
>>> score = ContinuousLogicalTimeline(length=16, uid="score")
>>> recording = ContinuousPhysicalTimeline(length=60.0, uid="recording")
>>> claim = MatchClaim.from_events(
...     {"id": "e001", "name": "Note C4", "start": 8},
...     score,
...     {"id": "e042", "name": "Note C4", "start": 45.5},
...     recording,
... )
>>> claim.event_a_id, claim.start_anchor.coordinate_a
('e001', Coordinate(Fraction(8, 1), quarters))
```

```python
>>> claim = MatchClaim.nomatch({"id": "orphan", "start": 12}, score, recording)
>>> claim.start_anchor is None, claim.claim_type.name
(True, 'nomatch')
```

### check_on_timelines { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchClaim.check_on_timelines }

```python
alignment.MatchClaim.check_on_timelines(timeline_a, timeline_b)
```

Refuse this claim unless every coordinate is on its timeline's axis.

Every coordinate the claim holds (both coordinates of each anchor,
and a NOMATCH claim's ``source_coordinate``, which is on the side of
its event) must be in its timeline's unit and declared number type.
Every factory that receives the timelines runs this check.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                | Description                                                                                                                   | Default    |
|------------|---------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| timeline_a | [Any](`typing.Any`) | Timeline A, or its ``(unit, number_type)`` pair. A timeline must be the one ``timeline_a_id`` names.                          | _required_ |
| timeline_b | [Any](`typing.Any`) | Timeline B, likewise. Either may be ``None`` where the claim holds no coordinate on that side (a NOMATCH claim's other side). | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description   |
|--------|----------------|---------------|
|        | \'MatchClaim\' | This claim.   |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                  |
|--------|----------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If a timeline is not the one the claim names, or a coordinate is not on its timeline's axis. |

### from_dict { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchClaim.from_dict }

```python
alignment.MatchClaim.from_dict(data)
```

Deserialize from dictionary.

One normalisation precedes validation: an absent timeline ID is
taken from the start anchor. A missing or null ``id`` leaves the
claim without one.

### from_events { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchClaim.from_events }

```python
alignment.MatchClaim.from_events(
    event_a,
    timeline_a,
    event_b,
    timeline_b,
    *,
    coord_key='start',
    end_coord_key=None,
    is_synchronous=True,
    certainty=1.0,
    provenance=None,
    id=None,
)
```

Case (a): Two events on different timelines correspond.

Each event's coordinate is placed on its timeline's axis: a number is
a position on the timeline, in its unit and declared number type; a
:class:`Coordinate` in another unit is converted through the
timeline's C-Map; a coordinate in the timeline's unit but another
number type is refused (:meth:`check_on_timelines`, which runs on
the claim made).

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type                                                           | Description                                                                                                                      | Default    |
|----------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| event_a        | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\]            | Event dict from timeline A; must hold ``id`` and ``coord_key`` (and ``end_coord_key`` for an interval match), may hold ``name``. | _required_ |
| timeline_a     | [Any](`typing.Any`)                                            | Timeline A.                                                                                                                      | _required_ |
| event_b        | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\]            | Event dict from timeline B, likewise.                                                                                            | _required_ |
| timeline_b     | [Any](`typing.Any`)                                            | Timeline B.                                                                                                                      | _required_ |
| coord_key      | [str](`str`)                                                   | Key for the start coordinate in event dicts.                                                                                     | `'start'`  |
| end_coord_key  | [str](`str`) \| None                                           | Key for the end coordinate (creates an interval match).                                                                          | `None`     |
| is_synchronous | [bool](`bool`)                                                 | Whether the events are temporally synchronous; a non-synchronous (conceptual) claim holds no anchors.                            | `True`     |
| certainty      | [float](`float`)                                               | How certain the claim is, in [0, 1].                                                                                             | `1.0`      |
| provenance     | [Provenance](`timetoalign.core.provenance.Provenance`) \| None | How the claim was made and who believes it.                                                                                      | `None`     |
| id             | [str](`str`) \| None                                           | The claim's id; without one, the first scope the claim joins mints it.                                                           | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description                                               |
|--------|----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
|        | \'MatchClaim\' | A MatchClaim naming both events, with 1 or 2 anchors when |
|        | \'MatchClaim\' | synchronous.                                              |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                       |
|--------|----------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If an event names no id, or a coordinate cannot be placed on its timeline's axis. |

### from_row { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchClaim.from_row }

```python
alignment.MatchClaim.from_row(row)
```

Reconstruct a claim from a struct-shaped Arrow row dict.

This is the entry point ``SemanticField.__getitem__`` uses to
materialise a scalar from the backing struct array. Every coordinate
cell (both anchors' coordinates and ``source_coordinate``) is read
as the coordinate it stores, in its unit and number type; the rest of
the row is the shape :meth:`from_dict` accepts.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                                                | Description                                         | Default    |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|------------|
| row    | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] | The ``.as_py()`` dict of one struct-column element. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description                          |
|--------|----------------|--------------------------------------|
|        | \'MatchClaim\' | A reconstructed :class:`MatchClaim`. |

### get_matchstamp { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchClaim.get_matchstamp }

```python
alignment.MatchClaim.get_matchstamp(
    bundle=None,
    from_graph=True,
    conversion_maps=False,
)
```

Return a MatchStamp for this claim's start anchor.

With ``from_graph=True`` (the default), the method builds or retrieves
the full MatchGraph for this claim's coordinate from the bundle's
cache and returns the FULL MatchStamp combining timestamps from ALL
groups connected at this coordinate.

With ``from_graph=False``, constructs a **reduced** MatchStamp from
only the two timelines in this claim (no graph construction needed).

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name            | Type                        | Description                                                                                                                                                         | Default   |
|-----------------|-----------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| bundle          | \'AlignmentBundle \| None\' | The ``AlignmentBundle`` containing this claim. Required for ``from_graph=True``. Provides group info and the MatchGraph cache.                                      | `None`    |
| from_graph      | [bool](`bool`)              | If True (default), build/retrieve the full MatchGraph and return the FULL MatchStamp across ALL connected groups. If False, return a reduced 2-timeline MatchStamp. | `True`    |
| conversion_maps | \'ConversionMapsSpec\'      | C-map conversions available through unit lookup. Opt-in: defaults to ``False``.                                                                                     | `False`   |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                   | Description                                           |
|--------|------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|
|        | \'MatchStamp \| None\' | MatchStamp with coordinates, or None if this claim is |
|        | \'MatchStamp \| None\' | non-synchronous (NOMATCH).                            |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                      |
|--------|----------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If ``from_graph=True`` but no bundle is available (neither passed nor set via ``set_bundle()``). |

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

A score and two performances, each in its own group, each
claimed at the score's quarter 8:

```python
>>> from timetoalign.alignment import AlignmentBundle
>>> from timetoalign.timelines.types import (
...     ContinuousLogicalTimeline,
...     ContinuousPhysicalTimeline,
... )
>>> bundle = AlignmentBundle()
>>> score = ContinuousLogicalTimeline(length=16, uid="score")
>>> _ = bundle.add_timeline(score, as_group="score")
>>> for n, seconds in ((1, 40.0), (2, 32.0)):
...     performance = ContinuousPhysicalTimeline(
...         length=seconds, uid=f"perf_{n}"
...     )
...     _ = bundle.add_timeline(performance, as_group=f"perf_{n}")
...     claim = MatchClaim.from_events(
...         {"id": "note_8", "start": 8},
...         score,
...         {"id": f"onset_{n}", "start": seconds / 2},
...         performance,
...         id=f"claim_{n}",
...     )
...     _ = bundle.add_match_claims([claim])
>>> # claim: score <-> perf_2
```

The full stamp (from the graph) reaches every connected timeline:

```python
>>> stamp = claim.get_matchstamp()  # uses the claim's bundle
>>> stamp.n_timelines
3
>>> stamp.get_coordinate_for("perf_1", format="float")
20.0
```

The reduced stamp holds the claim's two timelines only:

```python
>>> claim.get_matchstamp(from_graph=False).n_timelines
2
```

### implicit { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchClaim.implicit }

```python
alignment.MatchClaim.implicit(
    tl_a_id,
    coord_a,
    tl_b_id,
    coord_b,
    *,
    unit_a=None,
    unit_b=None,
    source_claim=None,
    provenance=None,
)
```

Case (c): Implicit claim generated by MatchGraph group extension.

An implicit claim is derived, never stated: it names no events.

| Name         | Type                                                            | Description                             | Default    |
|--------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|------------|
| tl_a_id      | [str](`str`)                                                    | First timeline's ID.                    | _required_ |
| coord_a      | [CoordinateSpec](`timetoalign.core.CoordinateSpec`)             | Coordinate specification on timeline A. | _required_ |
| tl_b_id      | [str](`str`)                                                    | Second timeline's ID.                   | _required_ |
| coord_b      | [CoordinateSpec](`timetoalign.core.CoordinateSpec`)             | Coordinate specification on timeline B. | _required_ |
| unit_a       | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.TimeUnit`) \| [str](`str`) \| None | Unit of timeline A's coordinate.        | `None`     |
| unit_b       | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.TimeUnit`) \| [str](`str`) \| None | Unit of timeline B's coordinate.        | `None`     |
| source_claim | \'MatchClaim \| None\'                                          | The claim that generated this one.      | `None`     |
| provenance   | [Provenance](`timetoalign.core.provenance.Provenance`) \| None  | How the claim was made.                 | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description                                             |
|--------|----------------|---------------------------------------------------------|
|        | \'MatchClaim\' | A synchronous, non-explicit MatchClaim with one anchor. |

### nomatch { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchClaim.nomatch }

```python
alignment.MatchClaim.nomatch(
    event,
    timeline,
    other_timeline,
    *,
    certainty=1.0,
    provenance=None,
    id=None,
)
```

Case (b): An event has no equivalent on the other timeline.

Creates a non-synchronous claim with no anchors, naming the event on
side A and the NOMATCH sentinel (``None``) on side B.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type                                                           | Description                                                                    | Default    |
|----------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| event          | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\]            | Event dict from *timeline*; must hold ``id``, may hold ``name`` and ``start``. | _required_ |
| timeline       | [Any](`typing.Any`)                                            | The event's timeline.                                                          | _required_ |
| other_timeline | [Any](`typing.Any`)                                            | The timeline on which the event has no counterpart (a timeline, or its id).    | _required_ |
| certainty      | [float](`float`)                                               | How certain the claim is, in [0, 1].                                           | `1.0`      |
| provenance     | [Provenance](`timetoalign.core.provenance.Provenance`) \| None | How the claim was made and who believes it.                                    | `None`     |
| id             | [str](`str`) \| None                                           | The claim's id; without one, the first scope the claim joins mints it.         | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description                                               |
|--------|----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
|        | \'MatchClaim\' | A non-synchronous MatchClaim with no anchors. The event's |
|        | \'MatchClaim\' | ``start``, placed on its timeline's axis, is kept as      |
|        | \'MatchClaim\' | ``source_coordinate``.                                    |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                     |
|--------|----------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the event names no id, or its start cannot be placed on its timeline's axis. |

### set_bundle { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchClaim.set_bundle }


| Name   | Type                | Description                                | Default    |
|--------|---------------------|--------------------------------------------|------------|
| bundle | [Any](`typing.Any`) | The AlignmentBundle containing this claim. | _required_ |

### to_dict { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchClaim.to_dict }

```python
alignment.MatchClaim.to_dict()
```

Serialize to dictionary for storage.

The values come straight from ``model_dump``; only the key order
and the omission of an absent ``source_claim_id`` are applied on
top, since both are part of the stored shape.

### with_belief { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchClaim.with_belief }

```python
alignment.MatchClaim.with_belief(belief, *, context=None)
```

A copy of the claim whose provenance holds *belief*.

Only the provenance changes: the belief replaces its actor's earlier
one, every other actor's belief stands, and a claim stated without
provenance gets an entry holding the belief alone. The copy is held
by no bundle (:attr:`bundle` is ``None``); a bundle records a belief
in a MatchClaim it holds with :meth:`AlignmentBundle.add_belief
<timetoalign.alignment.bundle.AlignmentBundle.add_belief>`.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type                                                                              | Description                                                                          | Default    |
|---------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| belief  | [Belief](`timetoalign.core.provenance.Belief`)                                    | The belief.                                                                          | _required_ |
| context | [Mapping](`collections.abc.Mapping`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] \| None | The JSON-LD context under which actors compare as IRIs; ``None`` declares no prefix. | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description   |
|--------|----------------|---------------|
|        | \'MatchClaim\' | The copy.     |
